<!---
Thanks for wanting to contribute.

Please do not bump the chart `version` in your PR — version bumping
and releasing is handled by maintainers: once your changes are merged,
a maintainer decides when to cut the next release and which semver
version it gets.

Want the chart to ship a newer Keycloak image? That's welcome: update
`appVersion` in the relevant `charts/<chart>/Chart.yaml` — the image
tag follows it by default — and any example files referencing the version.
--->
